headline: Recommended final passage of $231,941.29 agreement for Taylor Falls and Veterans Bridges rehabilitation; approved $36,630.78 Veeam software renewal.
summary: Approved a renewal contract with SHI International Corp for Veeam backup software, not to exceed $36,630.78. Recommended final passage of a resolution to accept an additional $231,941.29 for rehabilitating the Taylor Falls and Veterans Bridges. Also found compliance with the charter and ordinances for the record of expenditures from October 2 through October 15, 2026.
decisions: Approved a renewal contract with SHI International Corp for Veeam backup software, not to exceed $36,630.78, funded from General Fund/54-Property Services. Motion carried.

Recommended final passage of resolution R-26-075 authorizing the mayor to enter a second amended federal aid project agreement and accept an additional $231,941.29 for rehabilitating the Taylor Falls and Veterans Bridges. Motion carried.
Found that the Finance Committee complied with the City Charter and ordinances for the record of expenditures from October 2, 2026 through October 15, 2026. Motion carried.

REPORT OF THE FINANCE COMMITTEE
